secondary: Lending integration (Morpho Blue, Aave v3, Aave v4, Compound v3)
AMM integration (Uniswap v4 PoolManager, flash accounting)
classification.phaseEvidence: Deployed to Ethereum mainnet with live markets on four lending venues; low TVL; governance still the deployer EOA per AGENTS.md.

contracts.name: MarginRouter
contracts.notes: Inherits the clone factory, so the router is the manager of every account it deploys. The active account is derived from ReentrancyLock._getLocker() via the msgSender() override and never from calldata.

contracts.name: MarginAccount
contracts.notes: Soulbound ownership via Solady clone-with-immutable-args; no initializer, no transfer path. Owns every authority-bearing field: always passes itself as onBehalf, constrains every recipient to manager or owner, always a regular CALL never DELEGATECALL.

contracts.name: MarginAccountFactory
contracts.notes: CREATE2 salt is keccak256(owner, manager, subId); immutable args are (owner, manager). createAccount is public and unguarded but the owner binding makes address squatting self-defeating.

contracts.name: MorphoLendingAdapter
contracts.notes: Full repay is share-denominated (reads borrowShares) to avoid interest dust. Registry has no removal path: register() only overwrites.

contracts.name: AaveLendingAdapter
contracts.oracle: Aave account-level getUserAccountData, USD base currency
contracts.notes: Pool and dataProvider cached immutably from the addresses provider at construction. Reads are ACCOUNT-LEVEL: one-position-per-subId is a documented usage requirement the router does not enforce.

contracts.name: AaveV4LendingAdapter
contracts.oracle: Spoke getUserAccountData, Value units with RAY-scaled debt
contracts.notes: Supply is batched with setUsingAsCollateral through Spoke.multicall, relying on multicall being a delegatecall-to-self that preserves msg.sender. setMarket validates reserve underlying and Hub equality. Disabling deletes the route.

contracts.name: CompoundV3LendingAdapter
contracts.notes: Comet has no separate borrow/repay: borrow is withdraw(base), repay is supply(base). maxLtvWad returns liquidateCollateralFactor while Comet enforces the tighter borrowCollateralFactor at borrow time.

types.name: Market
types.note: (collateral, debt) pair. toSwapParams is the single choke point reconciling a v4 pool with the market; it validates CURRENCIES ONLY, not hooks, fee, or tickSpacing.

types.name: MarketRegistry
types.note: Morpho routing table; resolve() reverts MarketNotSupported for unregistered pairs.

types.name: Owner
types.note: Two-step ownership; zero address rejected on both write() and propose().

types.name: Ltv
types.note: WAD, 1e18 == 100%. type(uint256).max is used as an undercollateralized sentinel.

types.name: LeverageX18
types.note: WAD multiplier, sub-1x unconstructable. Not used onchain by the router; offchain/quoter helper.

types.name: PositionData
types.note: Consolidated position snapshot; deliberately carries no price fields.

libraries.name: MarginActions
libraries.note: Opcodes 0x30-0x38, leaving 0x1c-0x2f free for core Actions growth.

libraries.name: MarginCalldataDecoder
libraries.note: abi.decode helpers, chosen over hand-rolled calldata slicing for decode safety.

externalIntegrations.name: Uniswap v4 PoolManager
externalIntegrations.failureMode: swap reverts, partial fill on thin pool (guarded by ASSERT_FILL)

externalIntegrations.name: Morpho Blue
externalIntegrations.failureMode: market paused or unhealthy; oracle price stale or zero

externalIntegrations.name: Aave v3 Pool
externalIntegrations.failureMode: reserve frozen/paused; addresses provider repointed leaving cached pool stale

externalIntegrations.name: Aave v4 Spoke
externalIntegrations.failureMode: reserve config change; Hub migration; multicall semantics change

externalIntegrations.name: Compound v3 Comet
externalIntegrations.failureMode: collateral asset delisted; borrow factor tightened below liquidate factor gap

externalIntegrations.name: Caller-supplied v4 hook
externalIntegrations.failureMode: The pool key is a caller parameter, so the caller chooses which hook executes inside the unlock while the router holds swap credit and the active account is set. Market.toSwapParams validates currencies only.

tests.fuzzConfigBug: foundry.toml uses the invalid key fuzz_runs in [profile.default] and [profile.ci]; forge silently ignores it and falls back to runs=256.
